status: prospective threshold-calibration amendment before any perception output

amends.rule: v3.0.0, v3.1.0, and v3.2.0 remain binding; this amendment supplies only the previously missing executable development-threshold calibration rule

order: fit one entity threshold independently per pipeline using entity opportunities only
capture complete downstream SigLIP development score vectors on those scopes
integrate and replay all development observations through the frozen compiler
freeze settings and calibration provenance before validation
staging.gdino_entity: one threshold; entity opportunities only; replay the official postprocessor with identical box and text threshold
staging.egtr_relation: predicate and connectivity thresholds fitted jointly after entity scope freeze; binary-interaction opportunities only
staging.siglip: score threshold and minimum top-two margin fitted jointly and independently for each task and pipeline using only that task's opportunities
staging.count_and_geometry: compiler-derived; receive no fitted threshold and cannot influence entity calibration

ranking.tie_rule: higher threshold and then higher secondary threshold or margin win only after every observed development metric ties
ranking.fallback: if no candidate meets the preferred criterion in both strata, select by the remaining ranking fields and record preferred_development_criterion_met=false
ranking.metric_arithmetic: integer counts and exact rational comparisons; JSON reports may serialize finite decimal projections

abstention_and_failure.negative_abstention: no imputed false positive and uncovered
abstention_and_failure.non_abstained_prediction: covered even when its value is wrong
abstention_and_failure.typed_failure: all positive opportunities on the image are false negatives and all applicable opportunities are uncovered

score_requirements.grounding_dino: raw logits, boxes, input IDs, query/target-size/processor provenance, and postprocessed candidates for every grid threshold
score_requirements.egtr: threshold-independent object boxes/scores and ordered-pair predicate/connectivity scores with exact vocabulary provenance
score_requirements.siglip2: complete closed-label sigmoid score vector with label, prompt, crop, and scope provenance

inherited_unchanged: dataset size, families, splits, and support counts
Gate V3-A1 metrics, criteria, uncertainty, and resource limits
